notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

The team hasn't been in touch for a long time but we hasten to assure you: our work on the game has not stopped for a single moment. Since the April update, we have put a lot of effort into the development of ExTime: Primal Menace and we’re happy that now we can tell you about what we have achieved. Every detail we have been working on in recent months brings us closer to the final goal, and it is time to share the results of our work. 

Content. 

We actively  continue to develop the storyline of ExTime: Primal Menace and at the moment there are more than two hours of gameplay, which is built in a logical sequence. Each element of the story is worked out with attention to detail to create an atmosphere and dynamics that will keep the player in suspense throughout the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/90212ec745b2430718d4e93de5432e8aa03af689.gif[/img]

We realized that the current process for creating cutscenes was not efficient enough. This required us to review our pipeline and rework the existing cutscenes. Now we create cutscenes faster and at a higher quality level, fundamentally changing the approach to their development. As a result, the game already has over 10 minutes of story cutscenes, each of which helps to reveal the world and immerse the player in the story. 
 
Interface. 

One of the important improvements was the addition of an archipelago navigation system, i.e. an in-game map. The map turned out to be not only convenient, but also extremely informative. With its help the player can easily navigate the world, determine their current location and plan further steps. In addition to this, the map provides useful details about found but not collected items, which allows the player to go back without missing valuable resources. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/fb844a774ee3d26680018b637623f086339b7ce2.gif[/img]
 
Also we have significantly improved gamepad support. Now you can play with a gamepad, getting a full and convenient gaming experience. We have updated the interface elements, developed menu navigation and optimized controls so that interaction with the game becomes comfortable and intuitive. Gamepad owners will be able to fully enjoy the game without experiencing any inconvenience. 
 
In ExTime: Primal Menace we have implemented extensive options for customizing the visual component. Players will be able to choose ready-made presets with a certain level of graphics or adjust the parameters as precisely as possible to their preferences. Our settings system will allow you to change every detail of the image to achieve optimal quality and performance. 

Over time we plan to add explanations for each parameter in the settings to make it easier to understand which visual aspects change when they are adjusted. These text tips and visual demonstrations of effects will help you navigate the settings better and achieve the desired visual style or stability of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/2d298e66e9b0fbedbf27f63ab3ed06d00a5a40ae.gif[/img]

That's all for today, stay in touch and don't forget about our social networks!

notes.title: ExTime: Primal Menace new video!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We know it's been a while since we've shared any development updates, so thank you for your patience. Today, we're excited to introduce a new video for ExTime: Primal Menace.

This video gives you a glimpse of what awaits you in our game: an exciting survival experience, encounters with primordial monsters, and exploration of a mysterious world where the boundaries between past and present are blurred. Every decision you make will matter, and dangers lurk around every corner!

https://youtu.be/M72NkFB-trc?si=geo0fjd0LzpeSNvb

Don't forget to add ExTime: Primal Menace to your wishlist and stay tuned for more news!
Your opinion is of utmost importance to us, so we'd love to hear your impressions in the comments.

notes.title: Lady Player One
notes.content:
It's time to share the latest dev news! Let's start with the significant change some of you might have noticed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/5843dabaf95cfbfe8a1742606d2b06d0ad3dad30.jpg[/img]
Many games feature male characters battling against soldiers or predators, but in ExTime, you'll be able to experience a unique adventure as a female one. Meet Anna Hill — a young physicist following in her famous father's footsteps. She's also not a stranger to firearms, as she was on the skeet shooting team during her school years. 

She's known as a courageous, smart, and confident woman. However, she hasn't yet had a chance to show her skills in a life-threatening situation. Will she stay calm and not get driven by her emotions? You'll find out in ExTime: Primal Menace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/e692d44ea30cfdcd34203a9eae7351e08d63a856.jpg[/img]
While designing our character's appearance, we found inspiration in some well-known ones. We will give you a space here to make your guess. Who do you think Anna looks like?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/365fcd2fc00465afd5e0e50dbf5019153d092ff3.jpg[/img]
Also, we need to create a challenging environment for our character to reach her full potential. Precisely, this is what we've been doing. Whether it's solving complex puzzles or escaping from bloodthirsty predators while shooting, there seems to be nothing she can't handle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/c1764ed6ee34f6555e5a55f7e7863cb9991ce5fb.jpg[/img]
We're also putting a lot of effort into the room layouts, interiors, lighting, and reptile movement, and we are proud to say that it is going exceptionally well.

Although working on ExTime: Primal Menace will take a few more months, we sincerely appreciate your continued support for our project! We will surprise you with more information soon.

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hi all! Winter has come, and so is our new devlog!

[h3]ExTime: Approaching the first frontier[/h3]

Welcome to the tropical bounty in the middle of the ocean: a land of untouched nature and stoning views! Roar Island is our first island and that’s where your gaming adventure begins. On this very island, you’ll learn more about the storyline, drop by the scientific research facility, and maybe crush a prehistoric party. It’s been a while since we started working on detailed sites of Roar Island, as a matter of fact, we still do. Right now we’re upgrading weather conditions and lighting to make them look more indigenous and spot-on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/e1655827ab0ef726af052011dd7cccf08b205862.png[/img]
[h3]Animation and cut-scenes[/h3]

This month we've put our efforts into the animation improvement, focusing on main in-game enemies and also some cut-scenes. These are quite substantial for creating surroundings and various plot features. That is why we’re aiming not only to boost the animation quality but also to work into deeper emotional cinematics for you to dive into the ExTime: Primal Menace realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/a4efa494f0315ea6bc33fff198d4b89ebdc27346.png[/img]
[h3]Optimizing game for our invaluable community[/h3]

Image quality and smoothness play a pivotal role in the experience that you can get while playing. That’s why our efforts now are geared towards increasing the FPS so the game would run comfortably without decreasing productivity across various devices. Using the GTX1060 allows you to play at ease on recommended graphic settings even in the biggest locations. Moreover, further updates on this matter will bring even better rates. We're dedicated to ensuring that ExTime: Primal Menace is reachable and enjoyable for all players.

Thank you for your support and anticipation! We aspire to create a world that won’t leave you indifferent. Stay tuned as we are crafting something truly amazing!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends! We are glad to share our latest news with you, so if you wondering what’s new in ExTime: Primal Menace, let’s get started!

[h3]DETAILING LOCATIONS[/h3]

As you may remember, in ExTime you get on a specific island in Bermudas for scientific research. And, there is a lot of military stuff everywhere… Hmm, how can it be of use to us? Seems like it’s going to be one of the game puzzles for players.

Today we show you some screenshots of our military base. Firstly, you can see a construction near the main entrance, and by the way, do you have any thoughts, what it was built for? Anyway, we do not strongly recommend hiding there, while you're chased by a couple of predators. It may not be safe for you there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/3632ca3518f92d38cd259f6f9f93acb8e14e7483.jpg[/img]
Secondly, there is a warehouse backyard, where you can see a huge tank in a sinister embedded in a dark night atmosphere. What (or even who) could be in that tank — all questions and no answers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/a2349a39bc5fcef8764f7ab2237051283e10419f.jpg[/img]

[h3]CREATING VISUAL EFFECTS[/h3]

This part is the most sacred for all developers, but we still want to show you a piece of our work. So, what should you do to start a fire? 

At the beginning, all you have is a room, and of course, a plan of how you will add special effects in there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/9b7d9d74e7ecd140bf804b9943d9cc0c6800609a.jpg[/img]
Then the magic starts, or VFX, as we call it, and also don’t forget about logical elements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/5f6a4a97fcaf756b7f5b60cac7197ff9c0a798d5.jpg[/img]
If you do everything right, in the end, you have a perfect conflagration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/2043530075c33fb7f0a96504326632e21643aac8.jpg[/img]

[h3]GAME WITHIN THE GAME[/h3]

Mini-games often become a necessary part of a big project, and ExTime: Primal Menace is not going to become an exception. At every level, several puzzles will await you, and none of them will be easy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/250895fd53e1e54587f6a6ba3d4e7b5ea5a659c5.jpg[/img]
Cracking a code, getting access to the terminal, picking a lock to break in or out — these and lots of other quests will undoubtedly be in “ExTime”. Some of them may remind you of famous references but don’t get carried away, as solving these puzzles may be essential for saving your life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/4d07611ed91adfb5952b16e9b585c21cdd8bbad6.jpg[/img]

That’s all for today, but if you want to know more about our development progress, follow our socials on [url=twitter.com/vega_horizon]Twitter @vega_horizon[/url], or [url=facebook.com/vega.horizon]Facebook page[/url]! We weekly post new work-in-progress videos and screenshots, and communicate with you!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! Here is our devlog #3. We’ve been developing “ExTime: Primal Menace” for quite a long time and are ready to show you some new stuff.

[h3]THE OFFICE[/h3]

Not exactly what you might have thought, but this is where “ARROW” employees used to work. What is “ARROW”, and what kind of work did they use to do? To find out, you should subscribe to our social media! We’ll uncover this secret when we get 500 followers on our Twitter @vega_horizon. However, as you can see in these screenshots, we’re developing a dark horror game where fear and curiosity are your main companions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/89a2a223d8b63d4c295e0f4dc72ec1c2f7752071.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/a14f7ef3b02a9157d0b813ae2416098a4f70d74c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/b33e93f1ecaa9900508fca2f1d7efcd9671845b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]MODELING A FEMALE CHARACTER[/h3]

This has to be a real surprise for you, guys, as we’re announcing only for the first time that this supermodel will become one of the main characters in our game. You’ll get to know her closer in a few months, but currently, we’re still working on her appearance, mimics, and movements. Anyone likes to play for a girl in action-adventure games, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/46d1716c3ed7f959d6d7970759e6f7ad711b71d7.jpg[/img]

[h3]DETAILS MATTER MOST[/h3]

We want to make our game accurate and high-quality, so we can’t use just some default boxes and electronic devices. Our designers put a lot of effort into creating authentic pieces of art. Let’s show you some of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/9078699928fa343c47ec4a8843f38d43b4e668b2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/60d93babf504035147876d980be83195c82ff462.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/0f0f5499ac18a815fe84711c66acde458aabb8ee.jpg[/img]

We got to go, as there’s still much work for us to do. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello, world! Welcome to devlog #2 of our project ExTime: Primal Menace. There's been a lot of new stuff lately, so let's reveal everything step by step.

[h3]THE LAB[/h3]

The breathtaking sci-fi atmosphere awaits you. A lot of secrets hide behind these doors and corridors. It is one of the critical locations where the main character has to solve challenging puzzles and figure out the whole story of the place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/821d7233423f8eda177505b74c33db4ffb87b04f.jpg[/img]

[h3]CARNOTAURUS[/h3]

The BIGGEST news of the month is that we are adding a new predator to the game, the terrifying Carnotaurus. It is hungry enough to hunt you and fast enough to catch you. So it’ll be a real challenge to stay alive and well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/3f88b9ab5e560a1227b45752d92c407030bc168c.png[/img]

[h3]DISCOVERING NEW HORIZONS[/h3]

We’ve started developing our second island, and though it’s at an early stage, we’re ready to show you some pictures of it.
Just look at these screenshots! It's a true tropical paradise, and there will be more of it soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/26efaa0e2137f3c4970e89ddc98f6fe67ff4cad6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/d2d06c578fbce507cecdb3b9aa929b9b3fb1363a.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

We are so happy to be in touch with you again and share our latest updates in ExTime: Primal Menace game with you! We got so much news for you, so let's get it started.

Roar Island, Scarsmore Archipelago, Bermuda Triangle
Welcome to this seemingly paradise-like island in the Atlantic. Here starts your journey in the ExTime: Primal Menace. After The Event that brought predators from the past to our time, this island became the location for the main research base, whose mission is to find out the causes of time anomaly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/9e35fe589d97cfb2747911255d23fc23beb3888c.png[/img]
Deinonychus - hunter of humans
This dinosaur is considered to be a small one, however don't try to disturb him: it is still several times bigger than any human. The Deinonychus can be up to 3.3 meters long, and it has over 70 teeth in its mouth. Moreover, it is considered to be a sharp-sighted hunter, and it can spot its prey from a great distance. By the way, we almost forgot to mention that they like to hunt both individually and in small groups. Hide, run away or shoot back – the choice is yours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/55b3692f9f1c8a09171d57690d7e8187a1d26e1f.jpg[/img]
Quetzalcoatlus
This prehistoric pterosaur can be compared to a small airplane, as its wingspan is up to 11 meters, and it weighs about 250 kg. Soaring high in the sky, the Quetzalcoatlus menacingly watches its prey, and diving sharply down, will try to attack you with its paws and beak. Imagine what it would look like and now watch in action А теперь посмотрите в действии! Yeah, in ExTime, you'll have to look up a lot and watch out for this winged reptile's attack!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/b28c6438b2110f50be8992e0c370a7a9b4a77e47.jpg[/img]
We want to thank our community for the feedback on our social media! Thanks to the advice of paleontologists, we are able to create the game, that is most accurate to the details and that meets the latest scientific findings and research.

Thank you for your attention and stay tuned!

notes.title: Introducing ExTime!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are the dev team of "Vega Horizon Studio" and we are pleased to present you our new project - the game "ExTime: Primal Menace".

Inspired by the good old "Dino Crisis" and "Resident Evil" series, we decided to create our own horror adventure with all the essential attributes of the genre, but the author's reading of many game mechanics and a really exciting plot.

Will there be dinosaurs? More than you can imagine. Will there be puzzles? Of course, you will have to use your brains. Will it be scary? Undoubtedly.

The plans for this year include active work on the game and constant devlog: we will talk about the plot, about the characters, about the gameplay and about everything else that might be interesting.
We want to make the development process open and share all the details with you. Thus, you can go with us all the way, from the start of development to release.

What would you like to know about “ExTime: Primal Menace”? Write any questions, reactions, and feedback in the comments!
